text:
maria_cs: Heads-up — AlderTech reserved pool acceptance run scheduled TOMORROW 09:00 PT. Need final thumbs on quotas, autoscale policy, and the load plan. Can we lock owners?

raj_eng: I can drive the load run and metrics. What's the acceptance target? latency p50/p95 and error budget?

kevin_pm: Acceptance criteria we agreed with account: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 400ms for gen endpoint, error rate < 0.5% during 30m sustained ramp. Also verify cold-start times for cached prefix path.

olivia_ops: For quotas, AlderTech has committed 60 reserved GPUs. For the test we should cap to 20 GPUs to simulate first-week traffic. We can escalate but start small.

sam_sre: Notes: cluster has max pods per node 8, current node pool autoscale max = 12 nodes. For the test we'll set autoscale min=2 nodes, target CPU 60, and latency SLO probe on /health-route. I'll paste the policy I'm proposing.

sam_sre: ```
# autoscale policy (k8s/hpa-like pseudo)
minReplicas: 2
maxReplicas: 24
metrics:
  - type: CPU
    target: 60%
  - type: custom
    metricName: request_latency_ms
    targetP95: 350
fallback:
  - toModelVariant: small-quant
  - throttle: 20%
```

raj_eng: Load plan: steady ramp 0 -> 2k rps over 10m, hold 10m, spike tests to 6k rps for 5m, then burst-slices (10x short 30s). Using vegeta bot with KV-prefix warmup first. Command:

raj_eng: ```bash
vegeta attack -targets targets.txt -rate 2000 -duration 10m | vegeta report
# warmup script: python warmup_prefixes.py --keys 20000 --concurrency 50
```

maria_cs: Can we also capture per-token cost delta and per-route token breakdown for the run? Need it for the QBR and renewal conversation.

kevin_pm: Yes — engineering ops, add a metric export to datadog: token_cost_per_min, route_token_share. I'll own the cost slide.

olivia_ops: One ops ask: please disable cross-region failover during acceptance window — we want a single-region baseline. @deploy-bot can you lock region?

deploy-bot: region-lock: us-west-2 applied to cluster-aldertech-01 by olivia_ops at 2026-06-14T09:05:12Z

sam_sre: Failover plan if we see sustained p95 > 600ms or errors > 1%: 1) reduce target QPS by 40% via throttles, 2) trigger fallback to quantized variant, 3) open incident channel and notify CS.

raj_eng: I'll instrument the test with these extra checks: - warm cache step, - KV hit ratio, - token size distribution. Also will collect model kv-cache hit logs.

maria_cs: Who's on call for the acceptance window? Need 2 owners: infra + eng.

sam_sre: I'm SRE on-call for the window.

raj_eng: I'll be eng owner. I'll also post a short runbook link before start.

kevin_pm: I'll sit in for the first 30m for customer signals and take notes on any UX/regression flags.

maria_cs: Final checklist before start: 1) confirm autoscale policy (sam) 2) cap GPUs to 20 (olivia) 3) load script + warmup (raj) 4) metrics export for token cost (kevin) 5) region lock (deploy-bot done) 6) incident channel pre-created (maria)

maria_cs: If nobody objects I'll post the runbook and send the calendar invite now. :thumbsup:

olivia_ops: No objections. one ask — include the customer's contact who can give immediate permission to throttle if needed (legal/ops requirement).

maria_cs: added contact: alice@aldertech.com (ops lead).

raj_eng: Quick note: warmup script will take ~12m for 20k prefixes. We'll start warmup at 08:45 PT.

sam_sre: logging snippet for the warmup probe if helpful:

sam_sre: ```
[2026-06-15T08:46:12Z] warmup: key_prefix=0001..0200 status=200 latency_ms=85
[2026-06-15T08:48:30Z] kv_cache: hit_rate=0.82
[2026-06-15T08:50:00Z] readiness: true
```

maria_cs: Great — I'm posting the runbook in #customer-success-ops and pinging @alice. I'll update this thread after the run with a short postmortem.

deploy-bot: reserved-pool created: cluster-aldertech-01 reserved=60GPUs capacity=20active for acceptance-run by olivia_ops

kevin_pm: Thanks all. If we pass acceptance we'll schedule a 1-hour debrief with AlderTech next week to close onboarding and discuss renewal roadmap.

maria_cs: Perfect. See you all tomorrow 09:00 PT. :rocket:
